title: Sans regretz (Gaspar)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Sans regretz. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0505), edited by Paul Kolb (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. V. Settings of Liturgical Texts, Songs, and Instrumental Works, 2020); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 2018, Kolb, Paul. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
